Name: Curve Spline
Description: Defines the shape of the curve or spline used to remap or adjust values. The curve controls how input values are transformed, allowing for custom response profiles or non-linear adjustments.

Name: Mode
Description: Specifies how the curve is applied to the input values.

Flubs.Name: Absolute
Flubs.Description: Applies the curve using absolute input values, mapping the entire range directly according to the curve shape.

Flubs.Name: Relative
Flubs.Description: Applies the curve relative to the input's current range or context, allowing for adaptive or proportional remapping.

Name: Fit Curve
Description: Automatically fits or scales the curve to match the input range, ensuring the curve covers the full extent of the data.
